Advice from our doctors

ہمارے ڈاکٹروں کے مشورے

Caring for your newborn

نوزائیدگان کے بارے میں خصوصی ہدایات

  1. Feed only breast milk. Mothers should drink plenty of milk and water.
  2. Feed every 2–3 hours, and burp the baby on your shoulder after each feed.
  3. After feeding, lay the baby with the head and shoulders slightly raised.
  4. Never put surma (kohl) in the eyes, and never give honey or ghutti.
  5. Complete the full vaccination course.
  6. See a doctor at once if the baby turns blue, dark or very yellow, cries non-stop, breathes fast or with jerks, won't feed, vomits again and again or becomes drowsy.

Dr. Rana Muhammad Zubair Ahmad

Asthma in children

دمہ کا اصل علاج انہیلر یا نیبولائزیشن ہے

Cough syrups and antibiotics do not treat asthma. Inhalers or nebulisation are the real treatment, and with timely treatment most children outgrow asthma.

Dr. Rana Muhammad Zubair Ahmad

Diarrhoea: ORS and zinc

ڈائریا میں زنک کے فوائد

Give ORS to replace lost water, and zinc for as many days as the doctor advises. Zinc helps children get better sooner. Ask us for the right dose for your child's age.

Dr. Rana Muhammad Zubair Ahmad

FAQ

Questions parents often ask

When is the child specialist available?

Our child specialist, Dr. Rana Muhammad Zubair Ahmad, sees patients every Saturday and Sunday. Please call or WhatsApp us to book a time. The pharmacy is open every day.

Is there a lady doctor (gynaecologist)?

Yes. Our lady gynaecologist, Dr. Saima Zubair Rao, sees patients every Sunday from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. She offers pregnancy care, infertility treatment (including ovulation induction and IUI) and treatment for women's health problems. Call or WhatsApp 0302 5037681 to book.

Where is Adil Child Care Clinic & Pharmacy?

We are near Canal Rest House, Rohillanwali, Tehsil and District Muzaffargarh, Punjab 34400: Opposite Canal Rest House, near Meezan Bank. Tap Get Directions to open the location in Google Maps.

How do I order medicines online?

Add medicines to your cart, go to checkout and tap Place order on WhatsApp. Your order opens in WhatsApp; send it and we'll confirm availability and price before you pay. You can pick it up from the shop or ask about home delivery.

Do you deliver medicines at home?

Yes. Free home delivery on orders over Rs 3,000 within 5 km of the shop, in Rohillanwali and nearby villages. For smaller orders or longer distances, we tell you the delivery charge on WhatsApp before you pay.

Can I order medicines on WhatsApp?

Yes. Send us your medicine list or a photo of your prescription on WhatsApp. We will confirm availability and price, and keep your order ready for pickup.

Do I need a prescription to buy medicines?

Prescription-only medicines such as antibiotics are dispensed only against a valid doctor's prescription. Common over-the-counter medicines and baby care products do not need one.

Do you treat newborn babies?

Yes. Our clinic sees children of all ages, from newborns to teenagers. For a sick newborn, call us before coming so we can guide you right away.

What are your timings?

The pharmacy is open every day from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Our child specialist, Dr. Rana Muhammad Zubair Ahmad, sees patients every Saturday and Sunday. Please call or WhatsApp to book a time with the doctor.

Need a medicine or a check-up for your child?

The child specialist is here every Saturday & Sunday. Book on WhatsApp, call, or order medicines online.
